name: Booth Overflow

Keep its distinctive feature and environment; light comes from lamps. EDIT THE SUPPLIED ROOM PAINTING: preserve the focal object, layout, atmosphere and materials, but remove every ladder and shaft and overhead opening. Replace them with sealed brick ceiling and wall.
